subject.why: The subject is clearly a brass fairy lantern with glowing light and a flowering vine, resting on a mossy stone as briefed.

category.why: The background includes floating glowing light particles, violating the requirement to keep the background completely free of props, lights, and scenery.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, frames, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The lantern is nicely centered with ample margins around the edges.

colour.why: Vibrant and rich color palette with great separation between the golden brass lantern and the purple background.

detail.why: The moss features hyper-detailed, fuzzy micro-strands instead of being rendered with smooth, chunky stylized volumes.

style.why: The lantern itself matches the smooth, chunky 3D satin sheen of the reference cards.

fix: Remove the floating glow particles from the background and simplify the moss into smooth, chunky stylized patches without fibrous micro-texture.
